happy.label: Happy
happy.definition: A light, good feeling of pleasure or well-being.

joy.label: Joy
joy.definition: Great happiness that fills you, bright and strong.

delighted.label: Delighted
delighted.definition: Very happy about something good that just happened, like news or a nice surprise.

elated.label: Elated
elated.definition: So happy you feel lifted off the ground.

amused.label: Amused
amused.definition: Finding something funny, maybe enough to laugh.

playful.label: Playful
playful.definition: In the mood for fun and lightheartedness.

excited.label: Excited
excited.definition: Eager and full of energy about something.

thrilled.label: Thrilled
thrilled.definition: Very excited and pleased, often about news or something ahead.

exhilarated.label: Exhilarated
exhilarated.definition: A rush of excitement in the moment, often from something fast or daring.

proud.label: Proud
proud.definition: Pleased with what you or someone close to you did, or with how others see you.

accomplished.label: Accomplished
accomplished.definition: Proud that you finished something that took real effort.

triumphant.label: Triumphant
triumphant.definition: A proud high after winning or beating what stood in your way.

flattered.label: Flattered
flattered.definition: Pleased and a little proud that someone praised you or showed interest in you.

confident.label: Confident
confident.definition: Sure of yourself and your abilities.

brave.label: Brave
brave.definition: Ready to face fear or difficulty and act anyway.

empowered.label: Empowered
empowered.definition: Feeling able to act and make a difference, because someone or something gave you what you needed.

powerful.label: Powerful
powerful.definition: Feeling strong and in charge of what happens.

satisfied.label: Satisfied
satisfied.definition: Pleased that what you wanted or needed has been met.

fulfilled.label: Fulfilled
fulfilled.definition: Deeply satisfied that your life or work feels meaningful.

content.label: Content
content.definition: Satisfied with how things are right now.

calm.label: Calm
calm.definition: Settled and steady inside, with nothing stirring you up.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.definition: Loose and unhurried, with your guard down.

at-peace.label: At peace
at-peace.definition: Calm and settled, without inner conflict.

safe.label: Safe
safe.definition: Calm and sure that nothing here can harm you.

relieved.label: Relieved
relieved.definition: Lighter because a worry or danger has passed.

reassured.label: Reassured
reassured.definition: Less worried because someone or something eased your doubts.

forgiven.label: Forgiven
forgiven.definition: Lighter because someone has let go of a wrong you did.

vindicated.label: Vindicated
vindicated.definition: Relieved to be proven right after others doubted you.

hopeful.label: Hopeful
hopeful.definition: Believing that something good can happen.

optimistic.label: Optimistic
optimistic.definition: Expecting that things will turn out well.

encouraged.label: Encouraged
encouraged.definition: More hopeful about going on, thanks to a good sign or someone's support.

motivated.label: Motivated
motivated.definition: Driven to act or to work toward something.

inspired.label: Inspired
inspired.definition: Fired up to create or do something, because someone or something showed you what's possible.

determined.label: Determined
determined.definition: Set on doing something, whatever it takes.

interested.label: Interested
interested.definition: Your attention is caught by something, and you want to stay with it.

curious.label: Curious
curious.definition: Drawn to explore something new or unknown.

fascinated.label: Fascinated
fascinated.definition: Held so fully by something that you can't look away.

amazed.label: Amazed
amazed.definition: Surprised in a good way by something you didn't expect or think possible.

awe.label: Awe
awe.definition: Wonder at something vast, beautiful, or powerful, sometimes with a touch of fear.

impressed.label: Impressed
impressed.definition: Struck by how good or skilled someone or something is.

grateful.label: Grateful
grateful.definition: Glad and thankful for something good you received or have.

honored.label: Honored
honored.definition: Proud and grateful that someone chose or recognized you.

blessed.label: Blessed
blessed.definition: Grateful for the good in your life, with no one in particular to thank.

love.label: Love
love.definition: Warmth toward someone: caring for them, wanting to be close, or feeling their care for you.

tenderness.label: Tenderness
tenderness.definition: A soft, gentle warmth toward someone.

protective.label: Protective
protective.definition: Wanting to keep someone you love from harm.

cared-for.label: Cared for
cared-for.definition: Warm and looked after, knowing someone is tending to you.

compassion.label: Compassion
compassion.definition: Feeling for someone who's suffering, with a wish to help.

sympathy.label: Sympathy
sympathy.definition: Alongside someone in their pain, and wanting to comfort them.

moved.label: Moved
moved.definition: Stirred deeply, maybe to tears, by someone's suffering or courage.

connected.label: Connected
connected.definition: Close to someone, or part of something bigger.

understood.label: Understood
understood.definition: Seen and known, because someone really gets you.

valued.label: Valued
valued.definition: Feeling that others see your worth and appreciate you.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.definition: Feeling welcomed and included as you are.

attracted.label: Attracted
attracted.definition: Drawn to someone, by their looks, their personality, or both.

sad.label: Sad
sad.definition: A heavy feeling of loss, disappointment, or hurt.

lonely.label: Lonely
lonely.definition: Wanting connection and feeling alone without it.

left-out.label: Left out
left-out.definition: Lonely because you weren't included, maybe by accident.

misunderstood.label: Misunderstood
misunderstood.definition: Lonely because others don't get who you are or what you mean.

abandoned.label: Abandoned
abandoned.definition: Feeling left behind by someone you counted on.

hurt.label: Hurt
hurt.definition: Emotional pain from something someone said or did.

betrayed.label: Betrayed
betrayed.definition: Hurt and angry because someone you trusted broke that trust.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.definition: Hurt that someone pushed you away or shut you out on purpose.

unappreciated.label: Unappreciated
unappreciated.definition: Hurt that what you do for others goes unnoticed.

disappointed.label: Disappointed
disappointed.definition: Sad that things didn't go the way you hoped, or someone didn't come through.

discouraged.label: Discouraged
discouraged.definition: Losing heart after setbacks, close to giving up.

regret.label: Regret
regret.definition: Wishing you could go back and choose differently.

disillusioned.label: Disillusioned
disillusioned.definition: Let down after learning something isn't as good as you believed.

grief.label: Grief
grief.definition: Deep sorrow after losing someone or something you love.

heartbroken.label: Heartbroken
heartbroken.definition: Deep pain over a love or a close bond that ended.

devastated.label: Devastated
devastated.definition: Knocked flat by a huge loss or blow.

empty.label: Empty
empty.definition: Hollow inside, as if something that should be there is missing.

heartache.label: Heartache
heartache.definition: A painful longing for someone or something out of reach, or a pang for someone who's suffering.

homesick.label: Homesick
homesick.definition: Missing home and the people there.

nostalgic.label: Nostalgic
nostalgic.definition: Wistful about times gone by, with warmth mixed into the ache.

sorry-for-someone.label: Sorry for someone
sorry-for-someone.definition: Saddened by someone else's pain or bad luck, even from a distance.

down.label: Down
down.definition: Low and drained, with little energy for anything.

hopeless.label: Hopeless
hopeless.definition: Losing all hope that things can get better.

miserable.label: Miserable
miserable.definition: So low that everything seems awful.

defeated.label: Defeated
defeated.definition: Beaten after losing or failing, with no fight left.

ashamed.label: Ashamed
ashamed.definition: Feeling that something is wrong with who you are, not just with what you did.

humiliated.label: Humiliated
humiliated.definition: Made to feel small and ashamed, often in front of others.

worthless.label: Worthless
worthless.definition: Feeling that you have no value as a person.

inadequate.label: Inadequate
inadequate.definition: Feeling that you are not good enough or not able to do what is needed.

inferior.label: Inferior
inferior.definition: Feeling lower or less worthy than other people.

insignificant.label: Insignificant
insignificant.definition: Feeling small and unimportant, as if no one would notice you.

scared.label: Scared
scared.definition: A feeling that you are in danger or about to be hurt.

anxious.label: Anxious
anxious.definition: Tense and troubled about what might happen, often without knowing exactly what.

worried.label: Worried
worried.definition: Thinking again and again about something that could go wrong.

dread.label: Dread
dread.definition: A heavy fear of something that's coming.

suspicious.label: Suspicious
suspicious.definition: Wary that someone is hiding something or up to no good.

nervous.label: Nervous
nervous.definition: Jittery and unsure, about yourself or something coming up.

on-edge.label: On edge
on-edge.definition: Jumpy and braced for something to go wrong.

insecure.label: Insecure
insecure.definition: Unsure whether you measure up or whether people like you.

uneasy.label: Uneasy

terrified.label: Terrified
terrified.definition: Extremely afraid, as though something terrible could happen any second.

panicked.label: Panicked
panicked.definition: So scared that your mind races and you can't think straight.

horrified.label: Horrified
horrified.definition: Struck with terror at something awful you saw or heard.

shocked.label: Shocked
shocked.definition: Shaken by something sudden and upsetting.

stunned.label: Stunned
stunned.definition: Too shocked to react or take it in.

vulnerable.label: Vulnerable
vulnerable.definition: Open to being hurt, without your usual protection.

helpless.label: Helpless
helpless.definition: Feeling that nothing you do can stop something bad from happening, to you or someone you love.

exposed.label: Exposed
exposed.definition: Feeling seen in a way you didn't choose, with nowhere to hide.

threatened.label: Threatened
threatened.definition: Feeling at risk from someone or something that could harm you or what you care about.

angry.label: Angry
angry.definition: A strong feeling that something is wrong or unfair, with an urge to push back.

annoyed.label: Annoyed
annoyed.definition: Mildly irritated by something that bothers you.

irritable.label: Irritable
irritable.definition: Short-tempered right now, as if everything gets on your nerves.

impatient.label: Impatient
impatient.definition: Itching for something to hurry up, and annoyed that it hasn't.

provoked.label: Provoked
provoked.definition: Stirred up by someone who's deliberately pushing your buttons.

frustrated.label: Frustrated
frustrated.definition: Upset because something keeps getting in your way.

trapped.label: Trapped
trapped.definition: Frustrated and stuck, with no way out of where you are.

fed-up.label: Fed up
fed-up.definition: Had enough of something that keeps happening, and done putting up with it.

furious.label: Furious
furious.definition: Extremely angry, and hard to calm down.

outraged.label: Outraged
outraged.definition: Furious at something wrong or unjust.

rage.label: Rage
rage.definition: Anger so strong it feels like it could take over.

violated.label: Violated
violated.definition: Furious that someone crossed a line with you they had no right to cross, like your body, privacy, or home.

resentful.label: Resentful
resentful.definition: Holding on to anger about being treated unfairly in the past.

cheated.label: Cheated
cheated.definition: Angry that someone tricked you or didn't play fair.

used.label: Used
used.definition: Resentful that someone took advantage of you to get what they wanted.

offended.label: Offended
offended.definition: Angry or upset that someone's words or actions disrespected you.

insulted.label: Insulted
insulted.definition: Stung by something said to put you down.

indignant.label: Indignant
indignant.definition: Angry that someone questioned your honesty or dignity, such as blaming you for something you didn't do.

jealous.label: Jealous
jealous.definition: Angry that someone has, or might take, something or someone you want.

envious.label: Envious
envious.definition: Wanting what someone else has, and bothered that it's theirs.

possessive.label: Possessive
possessive.definition: Wanting to keep someone to yourself, and wary of anyone who comes near them.

disgusted.label: Disgusted
disgusted.definition: Sickened by something cruel or morally wrong.

appalled.label: Appalled
appalled.definition: Shocked and disgusted by something you think is very wrong.

contempt.label: Contempt
contempt.definition: Cold disgust for someone you look down on.

hatred.label: Hatred
hatred.definition: Lasting anger at who someone is, not just at what they did.

bad.label: Bad
bad.definition: Generally off or out of sorts, whether or not you can name why.

bored.label: Bored
bored.definition: Uninterested and wanting something to happen.

restless.label: Restless
restless.definition: Fidgety and unable to settle, wanting something to do.

unmotivated.label: Unmotivated
unmotivated.definition: Lacking the drive to start or do anything.

overwhelmed.label: Overwhelmed
overwhelmed.definition: Feeling like there is too much to handle, more than you have room for.

pressured.label: Pressured
pressured.definition: Pushed by demands or expectations from others or yourself.

burned-out.label: Burned out
burned-out.definition: Worn down by long strain, with nothing left to give.

confused.label: Confused
confused.definition: Unable to make sense of something.

conflicted.label: Conflicted
conflicted.definition: Pulled two ways at once, unsure which to choose.

lost.label: Lost
lost.definition: Without direction, unsure where to go from here.

numb.label: Numb
numb.definition: Feeling very little, as if your emotions have been switched off.

empty-of-feeling.label: Empty
empty-of-feeling.definition: Hollow inside, as if something that should be there is missing.

disconnected.label: Disconnected
disconnected.definition: Cut off from yourself or the world around you.

uncomfortable.label: Uncomfortable
uncomfortable.definition: Ill at ease in a place or with the people around you.

awkward.label: Awkward
awkward.definition: Unsure how to act or what to say around others.

out-of-place.label: Out of place
out-of-place.definition: Sure you don't fit in where you are.

embarrassed.label: Embarrassed
embarrassed.definition: Flustered by a silly or revealing moment, whether yours or someone else's.

foolish.label: Foolish
foolish.definition: Silly after a mistake you think you should have avoided.

mortified.label: Mortified
mortified.definition: Embarrassed so deeply you wish you could vanish.

cringe.label: Cringe
cringe.definition: Wincing at an embarrassing moment, whether you're watching it or remembering it.

guilty.label: Guilty
guilty.definition: Feeling that you did something wrong, and it weighs on you.

remorse.label: Remorse
remorse.definition: Deep, painful guilt over harm you caused.

apologetic.label: Apologetic
apologetic.definition: Guilty, and wanting to say sorry and make things right.

physically-disgusted.label: Disgusted
physically-disgusted.definition: Strong dislike of something gross, like a smell, a taste, or a touch.

repulsed.label: Repulsed
repulsed.definition: Strongly repelled, with an urge to get away.

squeamish.label: Squeamish
squeamish.definition: Queasy and shrinking back at things like blood, wounds, or bugs.

about.heading: Feels on Wheels
about.summary: A free feelings wheel and body sensations wheel, to help you find the word for what you feel.

sections.heading: What it's for
body: Naming a feeling precisely helps you understand it, and helps you tell other people about it. A feelings wheel starts from a few core feelings in the middle and gets more specific toward the edge.
The body sensations wheel works the other way in. It starts from what you notice in your body, like a racing heart or clenched teeth, and leads to the feelings that often come with it.

sections.heading: How to use it
body: Tap or click a feeling to narrow it down, and spin the wheel to see more. Open a word to read what it means and what you might notice in your body.
Switch between the two wheels at the top. Everything works with a keyboard, and it's built for screen readers. [Read about its accessibility]({accessibility}).

sections.heading: Install it
body: To keep it handy, install it from your browser's menu, or use Add to Home Screen on an iPhone or iPad.

sections.heading: Why it exists
body: I always had trouble identifying my emotions. For much of my life they only came out as anger, or I couldn't feel very much at all. Through therapy, journaling, and checking in with myself daily, I came to lean on a feelings wheel to sort out the words for my deeper feelings.
I wanted to make a version that's accessible, beautiful, fast, and versatile, for anyone else who needs help finding the words for how they feel. I hope it helps.

sections.heading: Credits
body: This app builds on feelings wheels by Gloria Willcox, Geoffrey Roberts, and Lindsay Braman, and on feelingswheel.com. The body sensations wheel also draws on research into where people feel emotions and what feelings pull them to do. Its definitions and sensations are written in its own words.
It was put together by someone without formal training in psychology, and it isn't a clinical tool.
[Read the full credits and the research behind the body wheel]({credits}).
[Think a word or definition is wrong? Tell us]({issues}).

sections.heading: Help translate
body: Would you like Feels on Wheels in your language? A language is one file of words. [Here's how to help]({contributing}).
